name: light-decision-mcp

tools.name: decide

state.description: The input context to evaluate: plain text string, JSON object, or JSON array.

questions.description: Non-empty map of named question definitions (noul, choice, or score).

images.description: Optional image inputs (up to 4): local file path (png/jpeg/webp/gif, <=10MB), data:image/...;base64 URI, or https:// URL.

mode.description: Routing strategy override: api_only, local_only, or api_with_local_fallback.

max_data_destination.description: Maximum allowed data destination boundary for this call: 'on-device', 'private-network', or 'third-party'.

web_grounding.description: Enable web-grounded decisions when supported by the target backend (e.g. Perplexity Decisions API).

allow_image_drop_on_fallback.description: Default false. If true and images are passed, permits falling back to a text-only local backend by omitting images.

tools.name: choose
tools.description:
Pick one option from a fixed set for a question about the state (and optional images), returning calibrated probabilities for every option and confidence.

options: array of labels ["a", "b"], or object {"label": "short description"} (descriptions help with terse labels).

state.description: The input context to evaluate: plain text string, JSON object, or JSON array.

options.description: At least 2 options: array of labels or {"label": "description"} map.

images.description: Optional image inputs (up to 4): local file path (png/jpeg/webp/gif, <=10MB), data:image/...;base64 URI, or https:// URL.

mode.description: Routing strategy override: api_only, local_only, or api_with_local_fallback.

max_data_destination.description: Maximum allowed data destination boundary for this call: 'on-device', 'private-network', or 'third-party'.

web_grounding.description: Enable web-grounded decisions when supported by the target backend (e.g. Perplexity Decisions API).

allow_image_drop_on_fallback.description: Default false. If true and images are passed, permits falling back to a text-only local backend by omitting images.

tools.name: yes_no
tools.description: Answer a binary yes/no (noul) question about the state (and optional images), returning answer ('yes'|'no'), probability_yes, probabilities ({yes, no}), confidence, and provider_confidence.

state.description: The input context to evaluate: plain text string, JSON object, or JSON array.

question.description: Yes/no condition or question to evaluate.

true_description.description: Optional clarification of what counts as 'yes'.

false_description.description: Optional clarification of what counts as 'no'.

images.description: Optional image inputs (up to 4): local file path (png/jpeg/webp/gif, <=10MB), data:image/...;base64 URI, or https:// URL.

mode.description: Routing strategy override: api_only, local_only, or api_with_local_fallback.

max_data_destination.description: Maximum allowed data destination boundary for this call: 'on-device', 'private-network', or 'third-party'.

web_grounding.description: Enable web-grounded decisions when supported by the target backend (e.g. Perplexity Decisions API).

allow_image_drop_on_fallback.description: Default false. If true and images are passed, permits falling back to a text-only local backend by omitting images.

tools.name: score
tools.description: Rate the state (and optional images) on an ordered scale (levels lowest first), returning argmax level & label, probability-weighted expected_level/score, per-level probabilities, and confidence.

state.description: The input context to evaluate: plain text string, JSON object, or JSON array.

levels.description: Ordered scale levels from lowest (0) to highest (N-1): strings or {label, description} objects.

images.description: Optional image inputs (up to 4): local file path (png/jpeg/webp/gif, <=10MB), data:image/...;base64 URI, or https:// URL.

mode.description: Routing strategy override: api_only, local_only, or api_with_local_fallback.

max_data_destination.description: Maximum allowed data destination boundary for this call: 'on-device', 'private-network', or 'third-party'.

web_grounding.description: Enable web-grounded decisions when supported by the target backend (e.g. Perplexity Decisions API).

allow_image_drop_on_fallback.description: Default false. If true and images are passed, permits falling back to a text-only local backend by omitting images.

tools.name: decide_batch
tools.description: Evaluate the same typed questions across multiple independent states with bounded concurrency (up to 64 states and 512 total state x question items). Returns one ordered result entry per state.

states.description: Non-empty array of states (plain text or JSON), up to 64 states.

items.description: The input context to evaluate: plain text string, JSON object, or JSON array.

questions.description: Named question definitions evaluated on every state.

mode.description: Routing strategy override: api_only, local_only, or api_with_local_fallback.

max_data_destination.description: Maximum allowed data destination boundary for this call: 'on-device', 'private-network', or 'third-party'.

web_grounding.description: Enable web-grounded decisions when supported by the target backend (e.g. Perplexity Decisions API).

allow_image_drop_on_fallback.description: Default false. If true and images are passed, permits falling back to a text-only local backend by omitting images.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read-only health and capability check (never triggers billable inference). Reports active routing mode, configured & auto-discovered backends, live circuit-breaker states, available decision models, data destinations, multimodal support, limits, and setup hints.

backend.description: Optional filter to inspect only one backend id.

data_destination.description: Optional filter by data destination boundary.

multimodal.description: Optional filter: true for image-capable backends only, false for text-only.

instructions: Light Decision MCP evaluates typed bounded questions (noul/yes-no, choice, score) with calibrated probabilities across multiple cloud and local System One decision backends (Magpie gateway, local OpenDecider, TypeSafe Jev, Perplexity, Google & OpenAI), supporting api_only, local_only, and api_with_local_fallback routing.
